subject: [PATCH v4 03/11] mm, swap: prepare the swap IO path for vswap

2026-08-25.patch_summary: This patch prepares the Linux kernel's swap IO path to support virtual swap (vswap) by allowing it to submit IO for a swap entry other than folio->swap. The current implementation derives the target device and sector from folio->swap, which is not suitable for vswap entries backed by physical slots. To address this, the patch introduces a new field in the swap_iocb structure to store the sector of the swap entry, and updates various functions to use this new field instead of folio->swap. This change enables the batching path to serve both vswap entries and physical entries mapped directly into PTEs without any functional changes.
